C dep009.ef-selected-provider OL DEP-009,DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Use the provider the project selected; do not add a provider because it appears in an example. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run006.ef-projection OL RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Projection is not mandatory when the entity is needed; avoid loading a whole aggregate to return two scalars. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-tracking EX RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Use tracking queries when loaded entities are modified and committed through the current Unit of Work; AsNoTracking() for read-only entity queries; projections to DTOs need no AsNoTracking(). ;; = ;; none ;; Tracking technique (EXC-011 context) phrased as a directive; not in the oracle.
C x.ef-query-shape EX RUN-006 PREFER ;; Prefer an explicit query shape (projection for selected related data, Include/ThenInclude when the graph is needed); consider split queries for large collection includes and verify the generated SQL. ;; = ;; none ;; Query-shape technique (EXC-011 context).
C run006.ef-no-lazy OL RUN-006 AVOID ;; Avoid lazy loading by default; it hides database access and invites N+1 queries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-deterministic-paging EX RUN-006 MUST ;; Paged queries need a deterministic order. ;; = ;; none ;; Stated in a code comment; not in the oracle.
C x.ef-bulk-ops EX RUN-021,ARC-016 MUST_NOT ;; ExecuteUpdateAsync/ExecuteDeleteAsync bypass change tracking: do not mix them casually with tracked entities for the same rows; understand their transaction implications. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C arc018.ef-transactions OL ARC-018 DEFAULT ;; A single SaveChangesAsync is the normal transaction boundary; explicit transactions inside Infrastructure only when a concrete use case needs atomic multi-operation saves; EF transactions do not solve distributed transactions. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.ef-compiled OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; EF.CompileAsyncQuery only on a measured hot path where compilation/cache lookup is material. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-interceptors EX ARC-019 MUST_NOT ;; Interceptors suit infrastructure cross-cutting behaviour such as auditing, not hidden business behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;; Interceptor technique (EXC-011 context) phrased as a restriction.
C pst006.ef-seeder-detect OL PST-006,PST-005 MUST ;; The seeder detects existing data through representative root entities and populates an already migrated empty schema. ;; = ;; none ;;
C pst001.ef-dataset OL PST-001 DEFAULT ;; A representative dataset includes created, active, completed, inactive entities, with/without optional values and relationships, representative statuses and boundary states. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-ask-dataset EX GOV-004,PST-001 MUST ;; When the required seed graph is complex, ask the task to describe the dataset instead of inventing a large generic graph. ;; = ;; Complex graph. ;; Not in the oracle.
C pst006.ef-no-patch OL PST-006 MUST_NOT ;; Migrating an existing Development database does not require the seeder to patch already seeded rows. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run001.ef-perf-checklist OL RUN-001,RUN-006 DEFAULT ;; Start with clear LINQ and optimize after identifying a real problem, inspecting round trips, columns, N+1, indexes, generated SQL, plans, materialized data and tracking overhead. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run008.ef-raw-sql-need OL RUN-008 DEFAULT ;; Use raw SQL only when EF Core cannot express the query effectively or measured performance justifies it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sec004.ef-raw-sql OL SEC-004 MUST ;; Prefer parameterization-preserving APIs (FromSql interpolation, FromSqlInterpolated, SqlParameter) over string concatenation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ef-no-fire-and-forget EX RUN-002 MUST_NOT ;; Do not fire-and-forget EF Core async calls. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.

35 NN ;; Heading.
37 MX [x.git-merge-convention,gov019.no-auto-stash] ;; Following team convention/explicit request and resolving conflicts from intended behaviour with verification afterwards are added; not automatically stashing, resetting or discarding local work is GOV-019.
39 NN ;; Heading.
41 MX [wf003.git-pr-verify,x.git-pr-description,wf009.git-no-false-claims] ;; Running verify before a PR (WF-003) and not claiming unrun checks (WF-009) are oracle-linked; PR purpose/description fields are added.
43 NN ;; Heading.
45 MX [u.git-destructive-approved-workflow,gov020.destructive-inspect] ;; 'Clearly required by an approved workflow' as an alternative authorization for destructive operations is link-uncertain against GOV-015; inspecting what will be lost first is GOV-020.
47 NN ;; Heading.
49 EX [x.git-report-state]

C gov019.never-discard OL GOV-019 MUST_NOT ;; Never discard, overwrite, reset, clean or otherwise destroy user work to make a Git operation easier. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov020.inspect-minimal OL GOV-020 MUST ;; Before a repository-changing operation inspect git status/diff/diff --cached and use the minimum operation; do not silently clean unrelated changes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf022.staged-scope OL WF-022 MUST ;; Before committing inspect the staged diff and include only the requested logical change; do not stage unrelated modified files. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-logical-commits EX WF-022 PREFER ;; One logical change per commit; implementation and its protecting tests together; no artificial tiny commits or combined unrelated fixes. ;; = ;; none ;; Commit-granularity convention not in the oracle.
C x.git-commit-convention EX WF-022 DEFAULT ;; Follow the repository's commit-message convention; otherwise Conventional Commits; use the body for motivation, constraints or migration notes. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.git-branch-naming EX GOV-016 DEFAULT ;; Follow an existing branch-naming convention, otherwise prefixes such as feature/, fix/, refactor/; do not rename an existing user branch to satisfy a convention. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov016.worktrees OL GOV-016 MUST ;; Separate branches and worktrees for parallel streams; a branch is not checked out in several worktrees; each worktree stays focused on its branch. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov019.worktree-removal OL GOV-019 MUST_NOT ;; Before removing a worktree verify its changes are preserved; never remove a worktree with uncommitted user work. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-push-checks EX GOV-020 MUST ;; Before pushing confirm the intended branch, understand working/staged state, ensure relevant verification completed and avoid pushing unrelated local commits. ;; = ;; none ;; Pre-push checklist not in the oracle.
C gov015.force-push OL GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Never force-push a shared branch unless the user explicitly requests history rewriting and understands the consequences. ;; = ;; Explicit user request. ;;
C x.git-protected-branches EX GOV-015 MUST_NOT ;; Treat main, master and other protected/shared branches as non-rewritable. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.git-merge-convention EX GOV-020 MUST ;; Merge vs rebase follows the repository/team convention or the user's explicit request; resolve conflicts from intended combined behaviour, not mechanical ours/theirs; run relevant verification afterwards. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov019.no-auto-stash OL GOV-019,GOV-020 MUST_NOT ;; Inspect local uncommitted work first; do not automatically stash, reset or discard it. ;; = ;; none ;;
C wf003.git-pr-verify OL WF-003 MUST ;; Run verify before preparing a PR. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-pr-description EX WF-009 MUST ;; A PR has a focused purpose; its description explains what changed, why, how it was verified and compatibility/migration notes. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C wf009.git-no-false-claims OL WF-009 MUST_NOT ;; Never claim checks that were not run. ;; = ;; none ;;
C u.git-destructive-approved-workflow LU GOV-015 ALLOWED ;; Destructive Git operations (reset --hard, clean, force push, force-with-lease, branch deletion, rebasing shared history) are performed only when explicitly requested or clearly required by an approved workflow. ;; = ;; Explicit request or approved workflow. ;; Open question: GOV-015 permits repository-changing Git operations only when explicitly requested; whether 'clearly required by an approved workflow' widens that condition (a relaxation) or merely describes an explicitly requested workflow cannot be decided from the text.
C gov020.destructive-inspect OL GOV-020,GOV-019 MUST ;; Inspect what will be lost or rewritten before a destructive Git operation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.git-report-state EX WF-009 DEFAULT ;; Report the resulting Git state when useful (branch, commit, push target, PR status, remaining uncommitted changes). ;; = ;; When useful. ;; Not in the oracle.

C api019.hc-liveness OL API-019 DEFAULT ;; A temporarily unavailable database or remote API should not restart the application (liveness without dependency checks). ;; = ;; none ;;
C api019.hc-readiness OL API-019 MUST ;; Include only dependencies required for meaningful readiness; keep readiness unhealthy until required startup work completes; liveness is not the mechanism because it triggers restarts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api018.hc-db-light OL API-018 MUST ;; A database check is a lightweight connectivity check without business queries, large scans or writes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-framework-integration EX API-018 PREFER ;; Prefer provider/framework health-check integrations where suitable (e.g. AddDbContextCheck). ;; = ;; Where suitable. ;; Not in the oracle.
C api019.hc-no-cascades OL API-019 AVOID ;; Check external dependencies only when their availability is part of readiness; avoid readiness cascades. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-status-mapping EX API-019 MUST ;; Healthy → success, unhealthy → non-success (configurable); probe semantics are not business API semantics. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api020.hc-small-protected OL API-020 MUST ;; Keep probe responses small; detailed diagnostics only on a protected endpoint (network or authorization controls). ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-exposure EX API-020 DEFAULT ;; Choose probe exposure by topology (private network, management port, RequireHost, authorization where supported); prefer orchestrator HTTP probes. ;; = ;; none ;; Exposure mechanics not in the oracle.
C api018.hc-cheap OL API-018 AVOID ;; Probes avoid expensive queries, long timeouts, large allocations and full workflows. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hc-no-error-logs EX RUN-013 AVOID ;; Avoid Error-level logs for every normal failed probe. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hc-testing EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; When deployment relies on the configuration test live response, readiness reacting to required dependencies, no sensitive leaks and optional dependency behaviour; do not test uncustomized framework behaviour. ;; = ;; Deployment relies on it. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hc-no-grading EX API-018 AVOID ;; Do not use health checks as a code-quality grading system. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api019.hc-no-chains OL API-019 AVOID ;; Avoid remote dependency chains without operational justification. ;; = ;; none ;;

C x.consistent-status EX API-003 MUST ;; Keep status-code behaviour consistent across similar endpoints (e.g. one convention for repeated DELETE of an absent resource: 204 or 404). ;; = ;; none ;; Consistency obligation not in the oracle.
C api003.put-201 OL API-003 ALLOWED ;; PUT may return 201 when it creates a resource at a previously non-existing URI. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api003.ha-202 OL API-003 DEFAULT ;; 202 fits long-running operations, background jobs, asynchronous imports and queued processing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.202-operation EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Return an operation identifier or Location for 202 when practical. ;; = ;; When practical. ;; Not in the oracle.
C api003.ha-204 OL API-003 DEFAULT ;; 204 fits a successful DELETE or an update whose representation adds no value; never with a body. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api004.ha-empty OL API-004 DEFAULT ;; For an empty collection 200 with [] beats 204, preserving the representation. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-304 EX API-003 MUST ;; 304 only for conditional requests with a still-valid cached representation, not a business 'nothing changed'. ;; = ;; none ;; Less-common status semantics (EXC-009 context).
C api005.ha-400 OL API-005,API-010 MUST ;; 400 for malformed JSON, invalid shape, binding failures and missing transport input, not for authentication failure. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-406-415 EX API-003 MUST ;; 406 when no acceptable representation can be produced; 415 for an unsupported request media type. ;; = ;; none ;; Content-negotiation semantics (EXC-009 context).
C x.http-422 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; 422 for structurally valid but semantically invalid requests, or 400 for both when the project deliberately uses it; follow the established convention. ;; = ;; Established convention. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.http-428 EX API-006 MUST ;; 428 when a contract-required precondition (e.g. If-Match) is absent. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in API-006.
C x.http-429 EX API-003 MUST ;; 429 with Retry-After when known for rate-limited requests; never for validation failures. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api007.ha-500 OL API-007,API-002 MUST ;; 500 for unexpected internal failures via centralized handling and ProblemDetails. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.http-502-504 EX API-003 MUST_NOT ;; 502/504 only when acting as an intermediary (invalid upstream response / upstream timeout); do not convert every dependency failure to 502. ;; = ;; none ;; Gateway semantics (EXC-009 context).
C x.http-503 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; 503 with Retry-After when meaningful for temporary inability (maintenance, required dependency down, chosen overload semantics). ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C api005.ha-401 OL API-005 MUST ;; 401 means missing, invalid or expired authentication; 403 cannot be fixed by resending the same credentials. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api021.ha-distinguish OL API-021,RUN-019 MUST ;; Distinguish client cancellation, own timeout and upstream timeout before choosing a response; not every TaskCanceledException is a 504. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api006.ha-409 OL API-006 MUST ;; 409 for uniqueness duplicates, incompatible state transitions, conflicting concurrent operations and reused idempotency keys; never for malformed syntax. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.ha-no-false-idempotency OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not claim idempotency merely because duplicates are unlikely. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.ha-idempotency-key EX RUN-016,API-006 DEFAULT ;; When a repeated POST must not duplicate effects consider an Idempotency-Key associated with request and result; a reused key with a materially different payload returns 409. ;; = ;; none ;; Idempotency-key convention not in the oracle.
C api006.ha-conditional OL API-006 MUST ;; Use standard conditional-request semantics (ETag/If-Match/412) instead of custom status codes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api001.ha-app-no-http OL API-001,ARC-010 MUST ;; Application expresses outcomes without IActionResult, ProblemDetails or status codes; the Controller maps them. ;; = ;; none ;;
C api002.ha-stable-codes OL API-002,FE-009 MUST ;; Machine-readable clients rely on stable error codes or contract fields, never human-readable messages. ;; = ;; none ;;

C arc025.hcf-shape OL ARC-025,ARC-007 MUST ;; Application defines the outbound abstraction and Infrastructure implements it with HttpClient; Application does not need to know the service uses HTTP. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-client-styles EX RUN-005 DEFAULT ;; Named, typed and keyed clients are all valid; choose the simplest for the consumer and lifetime; keyed clients only when keyed DI is clearer; no single mandatory style. ;; = ;; none ;; Client-style guidance not in the oracle.
C arc022.hcf-typed-singleton OL ARC-022 MUST_NOT ;; Do not capture a transient typed client inside a singleton without understanding the lifetime implications. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-handlers EX ARC-025 MUST_NOT ;; Use DelegatingHandler for genuine HTTP pipeline concerns (token acquisition, correlation, signing), never for business decisions. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run003.hcf-pass-token OL RUN-003,RUN-019 MUST ;; Pass the caller's token to every outbound call; CancellationToken.None only when the operation intentionally must outlive the request. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.hcf-timeouts OL RUN-015 MUST ;; Choose timeouts from the remote operation and latency budget; with resilience pipelines distinguish per-attempt from total timeouts. ;; = ;; none ;;
C arc025.hcf-translate OL ARC-025 MUST ;; Translate remote responses (including richer failure semantics) into the abstraction/outcomes Application consumes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-no-blind-ensure EX ARC-025 MUST_NOT ;; Do not call EnsureSuccessStatusCode() blindly when specific statuses carry contract meaning. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-no-status-passthrough EX API-003,ARC-025 MUST_NOT ;; Do not pass every upstream status through to the own API or map every upstream failure to the same status; outbound retry and inbound response are separate decisions. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run016.hcf-retry-safety OL RUN-016,GOV-013 MUST_NOT ;; Retry/circuit breaker are not mandatory; before retrying determine transience, repeat safety, remote idempotency and duplicate risk; POST/PATCH not retried automatically without idempotency/deduplication; do not assume PUT/DELETE implementations are safe. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.hcf-headers EX RUN-005 MUST_NOT ;; Configure stable headers on the client; apply per-request values per request or via a handler; never mutate shared DefaultRequestHeaders concurrently. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-json-contracts EX ARC-025,ARC-002 MUST_NOT ;; Prefer System.Net.Http.Json/System.Text.Json with explicit options when the remote contract differs; do not reuse Domain entities as remote contracts to avoid mapping. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.hcf-adapter-tests EX TST-003 DEFAULT ;; Test adapters with a controlled HttpMessageHandler verifying method/path, headers, payload, mapping and cancellation/failure behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C run005.hcf-tests-ok OL RUN-005 ALLOWED ;; Constructing HttpClient directly in a focused test is fine; the lifetime rule concerns production code. ;; = ;; Tests only. ;;
C gov013.hcf-no-blind-resilience OL GOV-013,RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add resilience pipelines without understanding their behaviour. ;; = ;; none ;;

54 MX [x.res-observe,gov013.res-no-otel] ;; Observing retries/timeouts/circuits when operationally relevant is added; not requiring OpenTelemetry for resilience restates GOV-013/DEP-002.
56 NN ;; Heading.
58 MX [run016.res-no-blanket-retry,x.res-circuit-breaker,run015.res-no-overlap] ;; Retrying every exception and hedged writes (RUN-016) and stacked overlapping handlers (RUN-015) are oracle-linked; circuit breakers without a failure scenario are the added circuit-breaker rule.
60 NN ;; Heading.
62-69 DU ;; Decision table restating the resilience guidance above.

C run016.res-match-semantics OL RUN-016,RUN-018 MUST ;; Resilience policies match failure and operation semantics. ;; = ;; none ;;
C gov013.res-no-default OL GOV-013,DEP-011 MUST_NOT ;; Do not add resilience mechanisms merely because they are available. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.res-standard-handler OL RUN-016 MUST ;; The standard resilience handler is useful when it fits but not mandatory; review its retry behaviour carefully for state-changing requests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C dep020.res-mex-apis OL DEP-020 DEFAULT ;; Application code normally configures the Polly-based Microsoft resilience packages through the Microsoft.Extensions APIs. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.res-attempt-total OL RUN-015 MUST ;; Distinguish attempt timeout from total operation timeout, especially with retries. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.res-no-unsafe-retry OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not retry non-idempotent operations without duplicate prevention. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-retry-categories EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Transient candidates: selected network failures, temporary unavailability, rate limiting when allowed, transient provider database failures; never retry validation errors, auth failures, permanent 404s or deterministic business rejections. ;; = ;; none ;; Explicit categories beyond RUN-016.
C run016.res-duplicate-unsafe OL RUN-016 MUST ;; If a lost response plus resend would duplicate a side effect, automatic retry is unsafe; use an idempotency mechanism the remote API supports. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-no-invented-key EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not invent a client-side Idempotency-Key the service does not honour. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in RUN-016.
C run017.res-honor-retry-after OL RUN-017 DEFAULT ;; Let the retry policy honour Retry-After instead of an independent aggressive schedule. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-circuit-breaker EX RUN-015 DEFAULT ;; Use a circuit breaker only for meaningful repeated-failure patterns that add load/latency; give it operational visibility when it matters in production. ;; = ;; none ;; Circuit-breaker technique (EXC-007 context).
C run016.res-no-hedged-writes OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Hedge only operations safe to execute several times; never hedge state-changing operations. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.res-db-resilience EX RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not wrap EF Core operations in a generic application retry pipeline; prefer the provider execution strategy (EnableRetryOnFailure) and its transaction guidance; an HTTP retry policy is not a database policy. ;; = ;; none ;; Database resilience technique (EXC-007 context).
C x.res-messaging EX RUN-016 DEFAULT ;; Publish retries may duplicate delivery; use idempotent consumers, broker deduplication or an outbox when the business requires it; retries do not give exactly-once delivery. ;; = ;; Business requires it. ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.res-inbound-429 EX API-003 DEFAULT ;; Inbound rate limiting is separate from outbound resilience; rejected requests get 429 with Retry-After when known. ;; = ;; none ;; Not in the oracle.
C x.res-observe EX - DEFAULT ;; Observe retry counts, timeouts, circuit state, rate-limit rejections and dependency latency when operationally relevant, using the adopted telemetry stack. ;; = ;; When operationally relevant. ;; Not in the oracle.
C gov013.res-no-otel OL GOV-013,DEP-002 MUST_NOT ;; Resilience alone does not require OpenTelemetry. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run016.res-no-blanket-retry OL RUN-016 MUST_NOT ;; Do not retry every exception or status or hedge writes. ;; = ;; none ;;
C run015.res-no-overlap OL RUN-015 AVOID ;; Avoid stacked handlers with overlapping strategies. ;; = ;; none ;;
